title: Using Facebook Ads for Groomers: A Guide to Growing Your Pet Grooming Business

facts.fact: The article states that Facebook has over 2.9 billion active users.
facts.quote: With over **2.9 billion active users**, Facebook is one of the most powerful platforms to advertise your services.

facts.fact: The article recommends starting Facebook Ads for groomers with a modest budget of $10-$20 per day.
facts.quote: Begin with a modest budget of $10-$20 per day.

facts.fact: The article's FAQ advises starting with a daily Facebook Ads budget of $10-$20.
facts.quote: Start with a daily budget of $10-$20. Increase your spending once you identify high-performing ads.

facts.fact: The article suggests targeting users within a 10-15 mile radius of the groomer's location.
facts.quote: **Location**: Target users within a 10-15 mile radius.

facts.fact: The article suggests targeting pet owners aged 25-60 who are likely to have disposable income.
facts.quote: **Demographics**: Pet owners aged 25-60, likely to have disposable income.

facts.fact: The article's sample ad copy offers 10% off a customer's first grooming session.
facts.quote: Book today and get 10% off your first grooming session.

facts.fact: In a case study cited by the article, a mobile pet grooming business in Miami increased appointments by 40% in three months using Facebook Ads.
facts.unit: % increase in appointments over three months
facts.quote: A mobile pet grooming business in Miami increased appointments by 40% in three months using Facebook Ads.
